hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for Clanker token pools that enforces asymmetric static LP fees — separate rates for buying vs. selling the clanker token — updated each swap via updateDynamicLPFee. Includes a time-limited MEV protection module (active for up to 2 minutes post-launch), automatic protocol fee collection (20% of LP fee), and LP locker fee claiming on every swap.
